text:
maria: Kicking off a short thread — ran a latency/throughput sweep for the new 65B q4f16 bring-up across h100 (us-east-1) and a100 (eu-west-1). Need a capacity forecast for Dedicated pools before we approve slots.

jon: Nice — what prompt mix and context lengths did you use? single-turn vs multi-turn will change warmup/KV behaviour.

maria: Mix = 70% single-turn instructions (avg 120 tokens out), 30% multi-turn chat (avg 800 prompt tokens). Ran concurrency points [8,16,24,32]. Command I used: `./bench/run.sh --model 65b-q4f16 --gpus h100,a100 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --concurrency 8,16,24,32 --warmup 3s`

lisa: Observed p99 spikes on a100 eu-west at concurrency=24 and 32 — looks like KV cache warmup and context-switch stalls. Example log snippet: `p99=482ms @24 -> p99=812ms @32 (a100, q4f16)`

kevin: Kernel note — the h100 runs my fused-attn kernel with perf gains. a100 falls back to generic matmul path in our current build. Try `KERNEL=fast_attn` build for a100 to test.

maria: Thanks, kevin. Baseline numbers (tokens/sec) from this sweep: h100 us-east @8=12.8k tps, @16=23.5k, @24=30.1k, @32=33.0k. a100 eu-west @8=9.4k, @16=17.2k, @24=20.8k, @32=21.0k. p99s mirrored those drops.

andre: For Dedicated sizing, what concurrency target per GPU are you trying to hit? committed SLAs ask for p99 < 300ms for interactive tiers.

maria: Our goal is to support 60 concurrent interactive sessions (avg concurrency per session ~20 tokens/sec) for the Enterprise tier in us-east during peak. Rough math -> need sustained token throughput ~24k tps.

lisa: Given those numbers, h100 pool: 2 GPUs (32k headroom) looks okay with 25% buffer. For eu-west a100, you'd need ~3-4 GPUs to hit latency SLOs because of poorer scaling and p99 regression. Also recommend warmup cache priming on scale-up.

jon: Also consider model variant fallback: if quant kernel/fast_attn still underperforms in eu-west, route to 40B q5_0 variant (lower latency) for non-premium tenants. Reduces Dedicated pressure.

kevin: Action item: I'll build a branch that forces `KERNEL=fast_attn` on a100 and re-run the 8/16/24 sweep. Add `--warmup 6s` and `--kv-priming` flags. Expect ~15-25% p99 improvement if kernel path works.

maria: Great. Can we also simulate autoscale headroom? I'm thinking initial Dedicated commit: us-east 4x h100, eu-west 5x a100 with autoscale buffer = 30%. Need to justify cost vs runway.

lisa: Autoscale policy suggestion: scale step = 1 GPU, cool-down 90s, scale-up threshold at 75% token-utilization, scale-down at 35%. For launch we should set min nodes = committed (so we meet SLA) and allow burst up to +50% for short spikes.

sre-bot: alert:scheduled-run 1719009200 started nightly autoscale-sim for 65B-q4f16 on dedicated-sim infra — results will be uploaded to /internal/bench/1719008765/ by 1719010400.

andre: For capacity ask in the sales deck, state: "Recommended committed: us-east 4 H100 (covers 60 interactive sessions w/30% headroom). eu-west 5 A100 (covers regional demand; fallback to 40B q5 for excess)". Include cost delta and expected p99s.

maria: Next steps: (1) kevin to push kernel build and rerun sweep, (2) lisa to run autoscale sim with warmup and KV priming, (3) jon to draft fallback routing policy for 40B q5, (4) I'll assemble a short slide with numbers + ask. Target: results by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
